description: Get a reproducible second read of a work-evidence package you hold before it goes to the human who accepts it: what the packet's own evidence list still lacks, what cannot be right (captured outside the stated radius, repeated frames, impossible clocks, the worker as the packet's creator), and the checklist the human answers, with one artifact hash anyone can reproduce. It reviews the package YOU supply, creates no order and no receipt, never accepts or rejects work, and 'no machine-checkable blockers' never means the work happened or was good. Free, keyless, moves no money.

package.description: The evidence package: workId, title, workType, standard, isDigital, location {lat,lng,radiusKm}, proofRequirements[], claim {workerWallet,claimedAt}, completion {workerWallet,submittedAt,gps,items[{step,type,hash,gps,capturedAt,data,bytesHeld}]}.

name: net_review_evidence
title: A dry-run independent review of a work-evidence package you supply
